counterfactual_missing_items: RT-PCR result not explicitly typed as RSV
Normal breath sounds without rhonchi or crepitations
decisive_items: RT-PCR tests from nasopharyngeal swabs: positive (Feb 8)
close contact with grandmother who had rhinorrhea and throat irritation
response.rationale: R3 has the most composite raw evidence: compatible URI symptoms, an exposure history, and an objective positive nasopharyngeal RT-PCR result. R1 is a reasonable symptom-level URI diagnosis but lacks a positive raw test. R7 is contradicted by normal breath sounds, no retractions/wheezing, and an essentially normal CXR; R4 has only rhinorrhea and conflicts with the negative respiratory panel; R6 is too nonspecific.

rejected.why: Only fever is cited; no anatomic or etiologic specificity in raw spans.
Tachypnea and normal O2 are outweighed by no dyspnea/wheezing/retractions, normal breath sounds, and essentially normal CXR.
Only rhinorrhea is provided as raw support; the negative respiratory panel conflicts and no adenovirus-specific test is present.
